wholePhysicalScope: The public-domain USGS and USDA aerial map and Stanford’s campus locator establish the site. The measured bearing of Escondido Mall sets the orientation. The published February 2009 exterior and the roof plan constrain the rectangular shaft and pergola registration.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the open belfry, four clock faces, steps and the paired colonnades. Close levels refine bells, hands, glazing and beams.
limitations: The 2009 tower exterior is reconstructed from one exact photograph and georeferenced campus controls. Two off-camera faces use symmetry. Belfry hardware, rail features, pergola arm extents and hand angles are approximate.
The original terrain is unchanged and the terrace stair fit is approximate. Separate campus structures and the clockwork mechanism are outside the model scope.
